title: profile.update
description: Replace a dynamic profile's definition, persisted to the registry (#25). Config-managed profiles are rejected (profile_protected); a profile with live sessions is rejected (profile_in_use); a missing binary is agent_unavailable. The whole spec is replaced, so seed edits from profile.get (#43); a "<redacted>" value (as returned by profile.info) keeps the stored value of that key, so the literal string "<redacted>" cannot be stored. Replied with profile.updated.
